title: Screw Unbolt 51
description: Tackle 51 escalating mechanical unbolting puzzles—relocate bolts smartly without jamming holes so every interlocked plate drops clear.
controls: Tap any bolt and move it to an empty socket to free overlapping plates and clear the puzzle.

zh-CN.title: 拆螺丝 51 关
zh-CN.description: 经典烧脑物理拆解拆螺丝 51 关：精挑细选 51 个层层递进的拧螺丝挑战，步步为营拆光铁板越玩越停不下来！
zh-CN.controls: 点击螺丝移至空位孔洞，逐层释放交错叠加的金属板直至全部掉落通关。
